column1: # Model aliases exposed by the proxy, in addition to (never instead of) the base model list.
# Every row is emitted with `fork: true` + `force-mapping: true`, so the upstream name stays listed
# and responses report the alias you asked for.
#   effort  : payload override baked into the alias, or "-" for none (client decides)
#             claude: low | medium | high | max         codex: low | medium | high | xhigh | max
#   tier    : optional, codex only — service_tier override (fast | priority | flex); "fast" is emitted as "priority"
# upstream may be written "catalog>wire" (claude only): the alias routes via a model the proxy's
# catalog already knows, but the request goes upstream as `wire`. Bridges the gap between a model
# release and the proxy's catalog learning it. Collapse to plain `wire` once the catalog catches up.
#   claude-code-version : Claude Code version the proxy impersonates (Anthropic gates new models on it)
# Cursor can't set thinking effort per request, so the effort lives in the alias name.
# TEMPORARY BRIDGE — upstream CLIProxyAPI's catalog doesn't list claude-opus-5-5 yet, and its
# baked-in Claude Code fingerprint (2.1.258) is below Anthropic's 2.1.280 minimum for this model.
# Remove the bridge when BOTH have merged, then `cpa server upgrade`:
